answer: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. A farm faking 243 aliases needs 243 separate storage accounts, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Cloud storage tenure with account creation date is the check: an account created years ago with continuous usage. Watch the forge: the farm pays per alias, the honest agent pays once, the canyon bond is locked until the epoch ends, and the quill audit is open to anyone who wants to re-run it.
